scripts.dev: concurrently -n hall,api -c green,magenta "npm run dev:hall" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host localhost --port 8000
scripts.dev:curator: concurrently -n curator,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.security:check: npm run audit && npm run audit:frontend
scripts.security:gate: npm run security:check && npm run security:lint && python -m pip_audit -r backend/requirements.txt && python -m compileall backend/app
